description: Allowlist of canonical axiom and explicitly approved primitive premise nodes. Each entry binds a STABLE un-dated claim_id to the current (possibly dated) source-doc path. build_citation_graph.py canonicalizes the claim_id of any listed path to the stable id, so inbound citation edges and the premise status survive re-dating of the source doc. PR3 attaches the axiom_premise meta-subtype + auditor carve-out to these ids; PR3's structural guard enforces that each listed doc contains only approved premise content (no framework-rule / ratification clauses). These premises chain-satisfy without bounding downstream rows; Tier-A derivation-target admissions live in tier_a_admissions.json and are the only accepted premises that bound otherwise retained rows.

minimal_axioms.note: Canonical Lattice+Qubit+Admissibility+Record axiom node. The source path may be re-dated; on re-date, update current_path and append the old path to aliased_paths so existing markdown links keep resolving to this stable id. The older observable_principle_from_axiom_note is not an axiom-premise node and must not be laundered as the Record axiom. The 2026-06-29 foundation reset, as clarified on 2026-07-02 and 2026-07-03, names physical sites as the cubic lattice Z^3 with nearest-neighbor adjacency, standard translations, and proper cubic rotations about each site, with no site privileged and sites distinguished by the supplied lattice structure alone; the domain of local possibilities and its full one-site algebraic presentation, with no possibility privileged and possibilities distinguished by the supplied algebraic structure alone; a fixed nearest-neighbor admissibility rule, covariant under lattice translations and proper cubic rotations, by which the available possibilities are determined by, and vary with, the nearest-neighbor conditions at each site; and fixed record readout: a site need not carry a record, and when present a record locks exactly one local possibility from the subset available at that site under Admissibility, and records are permanent; only records are readable, a readout value is determined by record content alone, and for any finite collection of pairwise-disjoint records, scalar readout I is additive, with I(empty)=0. A state is a configuration of records. A law privileges no states; its domain is a supplied condition, and at every state where the condition holds it gives exactly one answer. It still supplies no context-selection rule, occurrence rule, weighting, normalization, probability, update law, measurement/decoherence dynamics, record-production process, physical persistence dynamics, K/CPT structure, central-sector decomposition, source/action bridge, physical observable bridge, state-selection rule, law-domain derivation, or downstream theory consequence.

scale_reference_primitive.note: Explicitly approved framework primitive for the single dimensionful scale reference a^{-1}. Units conversion only: carries no dimensionless content and does not assert a/l_P=1. Dependencies on this primitive chain-satisfy without bounding downstream rows.

kinetic_isotropy_primitive.note: Explicitly approved framework primitive for the space-time kinetic-form isotropy c_t=c_s (OS0 graining isotropy): the emergent tick is grained on the same footing as the spatial edge. A dimensionless STRUCTURAL premise, the time-direction analogue of the Lattice axiom's spatial cubic adjacency; carries no dimensionless DYNAMICAL content (no mass ratio, coupling, mixing angle, phase, selector, readout bridge, or fit) and does not re-axiomatize emergent time. This primitive supplies only the kinetic form ratio, not an absolute scale, spacing-ratio theorem, dynamics, or downstream Lorentz theorem. Dependencies on this primitive chain-satisfy without bounding downstream rows.

realized_state_primitive.note: Explicitly approved framework primitive for the realized-state interface: the axioms select no state; a physical history fixes one law-admissible realized state, and derivations may evaluate at it POINTWISE only. Supplies the slot, never the content: no state, state-selection rule, measure, typicality/genericity assumption, weighting, probability rule, preferred/default state, or state-contingent value. Policing clauses: no averaging over alternatives; 'typical'/'generic' banned as specialization predicates; the counterfactual test (a quoted number must be invariant over the law-admissible family, else it is registered data); law admissibility. The past hypothesis is explicitly NOT housed here (a strictly stronger specialness input; anchored at the arrow note). Dependencies on this primitive chain-satisfy without bounding downstream rows; the primitive itself carries no contingent content, and rows quoting data of a particular realized state remain conditional on that supplied data as supplied inputs always are.
